If we have a bound of (say) K on the list sizes for the inner code, we know that |Lℓ ( gℓ , β + ε)| ≤ K for each ℓ ∈ L. By padding and ordering arbitrarily, we can take each Lℓ to be an ordered list of size K, with the i-th element denoted as L[i ]. If we only knew which of the K elements in each Lℓ equals hℓ , we would be able to recover the codeword h in the global list, since we would know it on almost all ℓ ∈ L (and then unique decode in the code Cout ). The task is then find the right i ∈ [K ] for each ℓ ∈ L, such that L[i ] = hℓ .
